entities.name: Café Apropo bombing
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Café Apropo bombing was a Palestinian suicide bombing which occurred on 21 March 1997 in a coffee shop in Tel Aviv. Three women were killed in the attack and 48 were injured.
